beats.say: Harry Kane wins his first Ballon d'Or
The ceremony took place at the London Palladium on 26 October 2026
He finished ahead of Kylian Mbappé, Lamine Yamal, Rodri and Lionel Messi
The Guardian reports 149,000 pounds in suspicious wagers are under investigation
Alexia Putellas claimed her third Women's Ballon d'Or
That 149,000 pounds equals about 3,000 average UK weekly wages

meta.summary: Harry Kane won his first Men's Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium, while Alexia Putellas claimed her third Women's award. The Guardian reports suspicious wagers are under investigation.
sources: Suspicious bets returning £149,000 for predicting Ballon d’Or under investigation
facts: Harry Kane won the Men's Ballon d'Or for the first time.
The 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony was held at the London Palladium on 26 October 2026.
Harry Kane finished ahead of Kylian Mbappé, Lamine Yamal, Rodri and Lionel Messi.
Alexia Putellas won the Women's Ballon d'Or for the third time.
Suspicious betting activity surrounding the Ballon d'Or results is under investigation by France Football.
The Guardian reports 149,000 pounds in suspicious wagers are under investigation.
